scope: Real native Emery QEMU UI and AppMessage requests with an explicit fictional protocol peer; no phone JavaScript, live plugins, real app launches or physical watch.

checks.check: First-use native button guide explains controls; dismissal consumes Select without dispatching an action or app launch
First-use guide dismissal persists across a native app restart; ordinary navigation works immediately and dispatches no action
Four-item Snapshot shows one activity, one notification and two pins; countdown advances locally
Timer tap has no action or enlarged view
Timer hold requests exactly one associated app and no action
Primary Music tap dispatches slot1 directly; hold opens its app exactly once without toggling
Music list tap is also direct; Back restores Snapshot without an intermediate media view
Native captures cover primary Music states, default value/action icons, a custom pin alias and long text
Notification tap directly requests native Notifications
Value-only pin tap has no action or enlarged screen
Unavailable reading does not disable an independent declared pin action or app route
Pin with no app ignores held Select without also toggling
Generic activity still opens useful labelled controls and runs its first available action
Activities hold opens once; list hold pages; Back restores the Snapshot pin
Held Down reaches12thpin; release adds no move, group switch or item action
Held Up returns to first pin in the same collection
Outdated view reply cannot replace the current native page
Source revision change during Select cancels the stale press
Native local focus survives insertion beyond the old page boundary
Shortened private lease clears Music and notification pixels immediately
SDK-reported disconnect clears private primary Music and notification regions
checks.transportNote: QEMU connection event and standard SDK debounce; protocol transport stays active, no real Bluetooth/phone link.

checks.check: Empty Activities accepts navigation and no-op actions safely
View timeout leaves usable UI; a matching late reply recovers
Phone-runtime restart accepts sequence1 in a fresh epoch; stale prior-session frame cannot replace it
Pending, success and failure feedback leaves the selected second Snapshot pin visible; values change only on successful synthetic source refresh
Selected permission/unavailable reading is explained while its independently declared pin action remains usable
Ordinary Music tap runs slot1; releasing Select at400ms after destination preview cancels without a tap or launch, while a completed hold opens Music exactly once
Select hold previews the actual Timer destination, launches it exactly once, and adds no tap action; a pin without an app does nothing on hold
Confirmation identifies Find phone and its action; Back cancels and Select confirms only the original bound request
Two controls show no invented third row; sparse 0/2 and sole slot1 retain original dispatch indices, stay bounded, and normalize focus after live removal
Snapshot with no activity or notification uses a neutral idle state and safely retains configured pins

visualReview.finding: Actual 200x228 screenshots reviewed by root and the native/model agents. Guide instructions and the 20px header clock fit. Both pins remain visible during pending, success, failure and offline states. Missing-reading reasons keep independent actions available. Hold preview names the actual app with a launch glyph; confirmation identifies its target with the contextual action icon in the right sidebar. Only present controls render, with original indices verified by behavior checks. Nothing active fits without a Timer icon. Long labels/errors use static ellipsis from the beginning; whole numeric values remain intact.
